locations.note: After a shootout at Pink Lenny's bar meeting, Tanner and Jones go undercover and trail Vasquez's men to hardware shipped from Cuba; Tanner later brings Lenny back here in custody.
Tanner wrecks Vasquez's operations but is too late to stop Lenny sailing for San Diego.
Under a truce with Solomon Caine, Tanner drives for his crew and destroys Vasquez's supply depot.
Tanner rescues Jones from Vasquez's gang, downs Lenny's helicopter with Jericho and arrests Lenny after the crash.

routes.name: The hunt for Pink Lenny
routes.note: From a Chicago gang war through Havana and Las Vegas to Rio, and back to Chicago with Pink Lenny in custody.
